idea-plugin.name: Layout Sync
idea-plugin.description:
Keeps the tool window layout identical across every open project window.

Moving, reordering, resizing, docking or hiding a tool window bar in one window is applied to all other open windows immediately and remembered for windows opened later. Settings Sync only carries explicitly saved layouts; this plugin syncs the live one.

Toggle it via Window | Layouts | Sync Layout Across Windows.

action.description: Apply tool window layout changes to every open project window
